description: List private posts in a community where this account is a member. Supports cursor pagination; requires read scope. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous community_threads call

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

name: community_threads
